samples.transcription_reference: 甚至当我们以这种方式去论定人的时候，我们就是一种静止的态度来看待每个人看待生活。这本身是需要你去好好琢磨一下的。如果生活真的是认定这个是对的人，一切就会以对的方式发生，那世界就变得太简单了。倒过来讲。
samples.translation_reference: Even when we judge people in this way, we adopt a static attitude towards each person and towards life. This is something you need to seriously consider. If life really were to confirm that this is the right person, everything would happen in the right way, then the world would be too simple. Conversely.
